content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Understanding Solana payments is crucial for creators looking to sell digital products without the constraints of traditional payment processors. Solana offers a blockchain-based solution that enables transactions with minimal fees, allowing creators to retain a larger portion of their sales. Unlike Gumroad, which takes a 10% cut, Solana payments through NOWPayments only charge a 0.5% fee. This difference is significant, especially for those making frequent sales, as it allows for greater financial flexibility and sustainability in your online business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for processing Solana payments involves several key components. First, you will need a digital storefront hosted on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. This serves as your online shop, where you can display your digital products. Next, backend logic can be implemented using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which handles order processing seamlessly. When a customer makes a payment using NOWPayments, the transaction is verified on the blockchain, ensuring instant and secure payment processing. This architecture eliminates reliance on traditional payment platforms and ensures full ownership of your sales data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment solution is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or heavily restricted. If you are a creator selling ebooks, templates, or courses in countries like Kenya, Venezuela, or Zimbabwe, Solana payments provide a reliable, cost-effective way to monetize your work. By leveraging this infrastructure, you can bypass the limitations of traditional platforms while maintaining full control over your sales and customer data.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, saving you significant revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To effectively utilize Solana payments for your digital products, you need several integrated components. Start with a hosting service like GitHub Pages for your storefront. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for processing orders and managing backend operations. Incorporate NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring that you can accept a wide range of digital currencies with low fees. Together, these components create a robust and efficient sales infrastructure, allowing you to focus on creating instead of worrying about payment logistics.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with Solana payments for your digital products, follow these steps: First, set up your storefront on GitHub Pages. Next, write and deploy your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment processing. Integrate NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments. Make sure to test your setup thoroughly to ensure everything operates smoothly. Finally, promote your digital products through your established channels, emphasizing the benefits of using Solana for secure, low-cost transactions.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Your digital storefront means no platform dependency.

For a comprehensive resource, consider The Sovereign Blueprint ($47), which provides detailed documentation on deploying your own digital storefront and accepting cryptocurrency payments. For more insights, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can sell an ebook by setting up a digital storefront using GitHub Pages and integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This allows you to bypass PayPal and Stripe entirely.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by creating your own online store hosted on GitHub Pages and accepting payments through NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5% per transaction.

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a variety of digital currencies for your products, providing flexibility for your customers.
